title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode3 Hesitation and Resolve

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Shinobi Battle”...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, I heard about that!
They're gonna hold it at Nonogi Park, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and the winners receive premium annual passes that give you access to the gym's private rooms.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
You get access to the private rooms for a whole year?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you want to compete in this event?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'll be nice to see what a brand-new facility has to offer, and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
If I decide to compete...
There's a chance that I'll be able to inspire hope in those who aren't all that athletic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some people said they wanted to dance like me, and this might be the push they need to start seeing the joy in exercising.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I also remember some people saying how they couldn't quite get the dance right, or how they're not as fit as they like to be.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but there's also some risk involved with you competing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. Members of the public will also be competing, so they may be startled by my presence.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And some of our fans may not be happy about me teaming up with people they don't know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that is a tough one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to enter.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If there's even the slightest chance of me helping our fans, then I want to do this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm all for you entering!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, the truth is... I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some people feel really bad about themselves after coming up short, even when they tried their absolute best...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They might decide it's impossible for them, and not want to try anymore.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... When things are looking really down, seeing your hero do her best can be just the motivation you need to keep on trying.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uhh...! At least, that's what happened to me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, seeing you team up with people I've never seen before would make me kinda jealous...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really love seeing you give something all you've got! It makes me want to keep rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure our fans will feel the same way when they see you doing your best, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know. What if we did a few streams of you training for this event?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By doing so, they should feel really inspired when they see you competing during the actual event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I really like that idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll need to do a good job of explaining everything to them. Let's start thinking about what we're going to say during our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Go, Haruka!
Do your best and win for us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Inspire a ton of hope in everyone by grasping victory!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I promise to do my absolute best.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Kiritani, Akito, thank you both again for agreeing to do this. Especially you, Kiritani. I know I'm asking quite a lot of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (After he invited me, we explained everything to our fans, and they seemed okay with me doing this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Now that I have their blessing, I need to do my very best during this event.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I never imagined myself forming a team with Haruka Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I look forward to working with both of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, there's no need to give me special treatment. I think it's best if we kept things friendly and informal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And, since we're doing this, let's do our best to win.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, absolutely.
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's begin by reviewing the rules!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Shinobi Battle consists of three stages.
Each member will be assigned one, and teams will be competing for the fastest total time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, we each just have to focus on finishing the stage we're assigned as fast as possible, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right!
And members are allowed to choose which stage they'd like to tackle to prepare for it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, Tsukasa Tenma, will be taking the first stage, which consists of the “spider walls” and the “log bridge”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the spider walls, competitors are tasked with crossing a space using two walls that they will find on either side of them, without touching the ground.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, like an actual spider, you have to use your hands and feet to stay stuck to the walls. That's going to really test your arm and leg muscles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and the log bridge is no walk in the park either. It simply involves reaching the other side by balancing across a fallen log...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But if you slip at all, there is a very real possibility of falling off entirely.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you've been doing quite a lot of strength training for your shows, Tenma. Tests of strength such as these are right up your alley.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, so you can leave the first stage to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That said, Akito's second stage isn't any easier. It involves the “high vault” and “water spider” obstacles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the former, one must launch themselves over a vault box, one stacked to be eight sections tall.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Call it twice the height of a normal vault box. I should be able to get over it. But it will test my jumping ability.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And then, there's the water spider...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's the one where you have to cross a pool using a pole while balancing yourself on a pair of inner tubes, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. The center of each inner tube allows a person to stand on it because it's covered up, so you can slide across the water's surface...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you'll have to control your center of gravity perfectly. Yes, you'll have a pole to balance yourself, but you'll fall in if you put too much weight on either float.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I thought this the first time we discussed these obstacles too, but I'll probably have to use muscles I normally don't...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, those sound a bit troublesome...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you run and do strength training every day as a part of your routine, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I imagine that's built your core up well. I'm sure you'll do just fine with a little practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
I'll just have to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally, Kiritani, you'll be tackling stage three.
That involves the “wall climb” and “hanging poles” obstacles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The former simply involves climbing the wall to reach the top. The latter entails leaping between poles that hang down from the gantry. This is by far the most difficult stage...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You also run the risk of jamming your fingers or injuring yourself in some other way after falling, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I will.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But I promise to do my absolute best.
So, let's do what we can to achieve victory.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we'll be counting on you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's it for the overall course...
In conclusion, we'll all be making use of very different muscles.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means we'll need to come up with efficient ways to strengthen the ones we're going to use. We don't have much time until the event.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Why don't we start by trying to come up with some good exercises for ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's something I'd like you two to see first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You want us to see something?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, these notebooks include training schedules that I'd like each of you to follow until the day of the event.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I designed them with winning in mind, so I hope you'll give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's have ourselves a look and...

rows.Speaker: Akito & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What...?!
